routeHint: Files in the left sidebar. Landing view shows one card per reachable drive plus the Latest files table.
alt: The Files home showing drive cards for the organisation, two group drives and the personal drive with file counts and storage size, next to a Latest files table with name, owner, date and size

routeHint: Files in the left sidebar, then the organisation card, then open the Reports & Financials folder and click the three-dot control on the first file row. The row control renders a vertical ellipsis, so the selector is .fa-ellipsis-vertical, not .fa-ellipsis.
alt: A drive folder listing with file rows showing name, owner, date and size, and an open row menu with Copy link, Share, Download, Remove, Move and Rename

routeHint: Share is only offered on a FILE row, never on the two folder rows in the drive root, which is why this has to walk into a folder first. The Share item must be clicked inside the visible dropdown: the other row menus keep hidden copies of the same label in the DOM.
alt: The Share dialog with two sections: Only in the community with a copyable 7-day link, and Anyone with the link with a Generate public link button

routeHint: Drive item 1660 is the demo tenant in-app document. The saved status indicator only appears after an edit in the same session, so it is not part of this shot.
alt: The in-app document editor with a rich text toolbar, the document title, a heading and paragraphs, and the word and character count in the header

routeHint: Settings (gear) then Modules then Files & eDocuments then Drive. Requires ADMIN_TENANT. Both toggles must be on so the Personal Drives card is rendered.
alt: Drive module settings with the Enable Drive Module toggle and the Enable Personal Drives toggle, both switched on
